newsitem.title: UK: Reuters European companies survey by sector.
newsitem.headline: Reuters European companies survey by sector.

text.p: The following are the top-rated analysts by industry sector in the 1997 Reuters European larger companies survey carried out by Tempest Consultants Ltd.
The analysts were rated by fund managers.
Autos JP Morgan Banks SBC Warburg
Building SBC Warburg Chemicals Goldman Sachs
Diverse industrials NatWest Electricals Morgan Stanley
Engineering Lehman Bros Food & drink Morgan Stanley
Insurance Fox-Pitt Kelton Media/leisure Deutsche Morgan
Metals/mining CS First Boston Oil/gas NatWest Securities
Paper Morgan Stanley Drugs/healthcare Goldman Sachs
Retailers Morgan Stanley Telecoms Deutsche Morgan Grenfell
Transport UBS Ltd Utilities Goldman Sachs
